Certification and compliance specialist Charles Wathen breaks down the essential differences between school bus certification and ongoing compliance, discussing how Blue Bird navigates evolving EPA, NHTSA, and CARB regulations. Discover how Blue Bird stays ahead of emerging challenges like cybersecurity and state-specific specs to provide a reliable, compliant multi-fuel fleet—including diesel, propane, and electric vehicles.
